outline: 介紹人因工程的理論基礎與實際應用之方法與模型，透過課堂報告與討論以及專題實作，使學生熟悉並俱備解決相關問題之能力。
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction (Ch. 1)
Week 2-3: Research and design methods (Ch. 2-3)
Week 4-6: Human information processing (Ch. 4-7)
Week 7: Project 1 (Memory)
Week 8-9: Display/Control (Ch. 8-9)
Week 10: Mid-term Exam
Week 11: Project 2 (Display/Control design)
Week 12-14: Work design (Ch. 10-13)
Week 15: Project 3 (Work design)
Week 16-17: Seminars: Applications of Human Factors (Ch. 15-17)
Week 18: Visit of IOSH Exhibition Hall (Ch. 14)
assessment:
Mid-term Exam: 25%
Projects: 3x20% = 60%
Reports of Seminars and Visit: 3x5% = 15%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

An Introduction to Human Factors Engineering (2nd. Eds., 2004) by Wickens et al., Prentice Hall (滄海)
